objectives: Choose the right form for a power of attorney, depending on the act it serves.
Draft the scope of a power of attorney so that it covers the intended act and nothing more.
Check a power of attorney presented by an agent, including revocation and sub-delegation.
Handle powers of attorney from abroad.
Certify the most common declarations and know the consequences of a false declaration.

cards.front: What form does a power of attorney to sell real estate need?
cards.back: Written, with **signature and content certified at the same time** (Art. 37 ЗЗД).

cards.front: Can a marriage contract or a will be signed through an agent?
cards.back: **No**; both are personal acts (Art. 39(1) СК; Art. 24 ЗН).

cards.front: What defines the scope of the agent's power towards third parties?
When may an agent sell the principal's property to himself?
Can the principal waive the right to revoke?
cards.back: **No**; such a waiver is invalid (Art. 38 ЗЗД).
If **authorised**, or if necessary to protect the principal (Art. 43 ЗЗД).

cards.front: List the grounds on which a power of attorney ends.
cards.back: Revocation, renunciation, death or judicial disability of either side, end of a legal entity (Art. 41 ЗЗД).

cards.front: Does revocation affect a third party in good faith?
cards.back: **No**, unless the end was subject to entry and was entered (Art. 41 ЗЗД).

cards.front: What does the notary enter in the information system after certifying a revocation?
cards.back: An extract with the parties, and the **number and date** of the revoked power and its notary (Art. 9а, item 2 Наредба № 32).

cards.front: How can a principal confirm an act made without power?
cards.back: In the **form required for the power** of attorney (Art. 42 ЗЗД).

cards.front: Fee for the signature on a re-delegation?
Which law governs the form of a power signed abroad?
cards.back: The law of the act, but the form of the **place of signing** is enough (Art. 61 КМЧП).

quiz.question: A client needs a power of attorney to mortgage her flat to a bank. What form?
options: Signature and content certified at the same time
Certified signature only
Simple written form
A notarial deed
quiz.explanation: A mortgage needs a notarial deed, so the power needs signature and content certified at the same time.

quiz.question: A power says: "to sell my flat in Sofia". The agent wants to donate it to his wife. Is it covered?
options: No, a sale power does not cover a gift, and contracting for a relative of the agent needs care
Yes, a gift is a kind of sale
Yes, if the price is zero
Yes, with a declaration of the agent
quiz.explanation: The scope is what the principal stated.

quiz.question: An agent with a power to sell wants to buy the flat himself. What is needed?
options: The principal's express consent to self-contracting
Nothing, the power is enough
A court permission
The consent of the notary

quiz.question: A power of attorney says it is "irrevocable". What is the legal position?
options: The principal can still revoke it; the waiver is invalid
It cannot be revoked
It can be revoked only by a court
It can be revoked only after one year
quiz.explanation: A waiver of the right to revoke is invalid.

quiz.question: The principal died last week. The agent comes to sign a sale under the power. What does the office do?
options: Refuses; the power ended with the death
Proceeds if the agent did not know
Proceeds if the heirs agree orally
Proceeds if the power is notarised
quiz.explanation: The power ends with the death of the principal.

quiz.question: An agent re-delegated his power to a friend, although the power does not allow it, and nothing urgent required it. What is the position?
options: The re-delegation is not allowed; the friend has no valid power
It is valid because the agent trusts the friend
It is valid if notarised
It is valid for movables only
quiz.explanation: Re-delegation is allowed only if authorised or necessary to protect the principal.

quiz.question: What must the office do right after certifying the revocation of a power to sell real estate?
options: Enter an extract in the information system with the number and date of the revoked power
Nothing more
Send the revocation to the agent by e-mail
Destroy the old power

quiz.question: A person sold a flat as "agent" without a power. Can the owner make the sale valid?
options: Yes, by confirming it in the form required for the power
No, never
Yes, orally
Yes, by a simple letter

quiz.question: A Bulgarian in Canada needs to sell a flat in Plovdiv. Which is a valid route?
options: A Canadian notary certifies signature and content, with an apostille and a certified translation
A scan of a signed letter
A video call with the Bulgarian notary
A power signed before a Canadian bank officer
quiz.explanation: The form of the place of signing is enough, and notaries expect certification of signature and content, an apostille and a translation.

quiz.question: Who can certify a power of attorney in Bulgarian at a Bulgarian embassy?
options: A Bulgarian consular officer
The ambassador's driver
Any embassy employee
Nobody

quiz.question: What does a notarial certification of a signature on a declaration prove?
options: Who signed it and when
That the facts are true
That the declarant has no debts
Nothing
quiz.explanation: A private document proves that the statements were made by the signatory; the notary certifies the signature.

quiz.question: Can a spouse sign a marriage contract through a power of attorney?
options: No
Yes, with signature and content certified
Yes, at a consulate
Yes, if the other spouse agrees
quiz.explanation: The marriage contract is concluded personally.
